visual.description: Two-tier threshold graphic. Top bar: CDC threshold — '<7 hours: 1 in 3 US adults' in #E8E0D4. Bottom bar glows red (#E06070): RAND danger zone — '<6 hours' with label 'RAND economic loss threshold'. A dotted line separates the two tiers. Dark bg, clean layout. The <6h bar is visually more alarming.
visual.textOverlay:
CDC: <7h — 1 in 3 adults
RAND danger zone: <6h

notes: Key distinction: CDC uses <7h, RAND uses <6h. All RAND-cited graphics must use <6h threshold per production flag #5.
